gloss: to become accustomed to seeing; to get used to seeing

definitions.gloss: to become accustomed to seeing; to get used to seeing
definitions.explanation: to no longer find something unusual or striking after seeing it many times

examples.japanese: {見慣|みな}れた{風景|ふうけい}だ。
この{町|まち}にも{見慣|みな}れてきた。
examples.english: I've gotten used to seeing this town.

examples.japanese: {最初|さいしょ}は{驚|おどろ}いたが、{毎日|まいにち}{見|み}ているうちに{見慣|みな}れてしまった。
examples.english: At first I was surprised, but after seeing it every day, I got used to it.

notes:
{見慣|みな}れる is a compound verb combining {見|み}る (to see) + {慣|な}れる (to become accustomed), meaning to become accustomed to seeing something.

VERB TYPE: Ichidan verb (ru-verb), intransitive

CONJUGATION:
- {見慣|みな}れない (negative)
- {見慣|みな}れた (past/adjectival)
- {見慣|みな}れて (te-form)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見慣|みな}れた + noun (familiar ~): {見慣|みな}れた{顔|かお} (familiar face)
- 〜に{見慣|みな}れる (to get used to seeing ~)
- {見慣|みな}れない + noun (unfamiliar ~): {見慣|みな}れない{人|ひと} (unfamiliar person)

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {聞|き}き{慣|な}れる (to get used to hearing)
- {食|た}べ{慣|な}れる (to get used to eating)
- {使|つか}い{慣|な}れる (to get used to using)
